warnings.message: Vision review hint (not blocking, the critic passed with mean 4.00): readability scored 3/5. Tables are crisp, but on the fleet cards the score rings show 0 for R-03/R-02/R-01 and the progress bars are empty for the top three robots (bars appear to show a gap-to-next-tier), so the numbers seem to contradict each other; the thin small gray text is also faint. Fix: On the Robots screen, make the ring value match the score (R-03 should show 50, R-02 should show 62 and R-01 should show 75, not 0), and make the bars show the score so they are not empty for robots that are already high; raise the contrast of the small gray sub-labels.

Vision review hint (not blocking, the critic passed with mean 4.00): layout scored 3/5. The fleet screen has very tall cards with large empty areas at the bottom of the shorter ones, and R-03's card is far taller than its neighbours; the 1440 px width leaves wide side margins and the Prints screen leaves a blank area under the status chart. Fix: On the Robots screen, shorten the cards by showing the five subsystems in a compact two-column or mini-table style and capping the prerequisites, so all six cards have equal height; on Prints, fill the space under the 'Pièces par statut' card (for example by moving a KPI tile there or stretching the chart card to match the three KPI cards).

parity.reason: Domain-specific data (IM/CMD/RP IDs, grams and hours, €, material types) and detail are on par with the reference, but the fleet cards are tall and repetitive and the progress rings and bars look partly broken.

reasons.hierarchy: Titles, the single primary button, KPI tiles and the red-bordered alert banner are clear on each screen, but the robot cards on the fleet screen give equal weight to every row.
reasons.realism: IDs, units (g, h, €, kg), materials such as PETG/PA-CF/TPU, suppliers and the Hexa/RP-04 storyline are plausible, varied and cross-linked.
reasons.consistency: Cards, tables, badges, buttons and filters look the same across all screens and the dark theme looks deliberate, though the fleet cards differ slightly in structure (R-03 has a different header).
reasons.readability: Tables are crisp, but on the fleet cards the score rings show 0 for R-03/R-02/R-01 and the progress bars are empty for the top three robots (bars appear to show a gap-to-next-tier), so the numbers seem to contradict each other; the thin small gray text is also faint.
reasons.layout: The fleet screen has very tall cards with large empty areas at the bottom of the shorter ones, and R-03's card is far taller than its neighbours; the 1440 px width leaves wide side margins and the Prints screen leaves a blank area under the status chart.
reasons.fit: The screens cover tiers, a robot sheet with prerequisites, prints, orders, stock and repairs/versions, which fits the idea of a robot-building workshop exactly.
